additional_details: Joyent has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://help.joyent.com/entries/98788667-Security-Advisory-ZDI-CAN-3263-ZDI-CAN-3284-and-ZDI-CAN-3364-Vulnerabilities
search_text: published ZDI-16-170 ZDI-CAN-3364 Joyent SmartOS Linux Zone Escape SS Exception Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2016-02-18 6.9 AV:L/AC:M/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Joyent'] ['SmartOS'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Joyent SmartOS. An attacker must be logged in as a user on the system in order to execute the attack. The specific flaw exists within the handling of an SS Exception. The stack segment fault handling code allows for a GS register to be user controlled. This allows an attacker to elevate privileges to escape a Linux zone and achieve privileged execution on the global zone. Joyent has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://help.joyent.com/entries/98788667-Security-Advisory-ZDI-CAN-3263-ZDI-CAN-3284-and-ZDI-CAN-3364-Vulnerabilities ['2015-11-04 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2016-02-18 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Ben Murphy https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-16-170/
title: Joyent SmartOS Linux Zone Escape SS Exception Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Joyent SmartOS. An attacker must be logged in as a user on the system in order to execute the attack. The specific flaw exists within the handling of an SS Exception. The stack segment fault handling code allows for a GS register to be user controlled. This allows an attacker to elevate privileges to escape a Linux zone and achieve privileged execution on the global zone.
